meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过语言服务器检查代码错误、查找定义和引用、查看符号,并在重命名前做安全检查。
howto.when: 当你在当前工作区要求做代码诊断、符号定位或安全重命名等 LSP 操作时。

say.text: 帮我检查这个文件有没有报错
say.note: 会运行语言服务器诊断,报告错误和警告。

say.text: 跳到 login 函数的定义处
say.note: 会定位并打开 login 函数的定义位置。

say.text: 重命名变量 session,先检查安全性
say.note: 会先验证可重命名性,再执行重命名。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use language-server tools to check diagnostics, find definitions and references, inspect symbols, and verify renames for safety.
howto.when_en: When you ask Codex to perform LSP operations such as diagnostics, symbol lookup, or safe rename in the current workspace.

say_en.note: Runs LSP diagnostics and reports errors/warnings.

say_en.text: Jump to the definition of login
say_en.note: Finds and opens the login definition.

say_en.text: Rename the session variable after checking safety
